sentences.japanese: 気の毒な光景は私たちの涙をさそった。
sentences.english: The pitiful sight moved us to tears.

sentences.japanese: 我々は彼の間違いを気の毒に思う。
sentences.english: We are sorry for his mistake.

sentences.japanese: もし子供が毒を飲んだら病院に急いで連れて行きなさい。
sentences.english: If your child drinks poison, rush him to the hospital.

sentences.japanese: ヘビの中には毒を持つものもある。
